name: staff-role-list-parent-id-fix
title: Fix staff role list parent id serialization
description: Map lean ParentRole _id values to the non-null GraphQL id field so the add-employee modal can consume roleList data from MongoDB.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Flow traced: Mongo Role/ParentRole -> UserQuery.roleList -> Role.parentRole GraphQL field -> Apollo roleList -> EmployeeFormModal validation. The role query requests parentRole.id, but populated lean ParentRole values only expose _id and no ParentRole type resolver currently maps it to id.
